description: Lists newly raised and closed venture capital funds verified from SEC EDGAR Form D Venture Capital Fund filings and primary firm announcements, matched against the Mode VC Investor Atlas. Read-only lookup returning fund name, firm slug, fund size USD, announced date, and source URLs.

atlas_only.description: When true, return only funds matched to an Investor Atlas firm page.

early_stage_only.description: When true, filter to funds sized or focused on pre-seed, seed, or early-stage rounds.

min_amount_usd.description: Minimum reported fund close size in US dollars.

query.description: Case-insensitive text filter across firm name, fund name, or location.

vintage.description: Alias for year (filter by vintage year, for example 2025 or 2026).

year.description: Filter by closing or filing year (for example 2026).

name: get_newly_closed_vc_funds
title: Recently Closed Venture Capital Funds (SEC Form D and Primary Sources)
